parsed.headline: Claim denied: No diabetes diagnosis documented.
parsed.explanation: This claim is denied because the record does not show the beneficiary has diabetes mellitus, as required by: "The beneficiary has diabetes mellitus (Refer to the ICD-10 code list in the LCD-related Policy Article for applicable diagnoses); and,". Without a documented diabetes diagnosis, coverage criteria are not met.
parsed.what_to_do: Review the patient's diagnosis and submit corrected documentation if appropriate.
